ARG BUILDKIT_SBOM_SCAN_CONTEXT=true
ARG BUILDKIT_SBOM_SCAN_STAGE=true
ARG PRESQUASH_SCRIPTS="rm -rf /tmp/* /usr/share/doc/* /var/lib/apt/lists/*; find /var/cache /var/log -type f -delete"
FROM scratch AS temp-<id>
COPY --link --from=<image> / /
FROM temp-<id> AS temp-<id>-cleaned
ENV PATH="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
ARG PRESQUASH_SCRIPTS
RUN sh -c "$PRESQUASH_SCRIPTS" || true
FROM temp-<id>${PRESQUASH_SCRIPTS:+-cleaned} AS temp-<id>-final
FROM scratch AS squashed-<id>
COPY --link --from=temp-<id>-final / /
LABEL "org.opencontainers.image.created"="2026-11-06T10:31:00.336187+00:00"
LABEL "org.opencontainers.image.description"="The Ubuntu container image maintained by Canonical\n\nUbuntu is a Debian-based Linux operating system that runs from the desktop to the cloud, to all your internet connected things.\nIt is the world's most popular operating system across public clouds and OpenStack clouds.\nIt is the number one platform for containers; from Docker to Kubernetes to LXD, Ubuntu can run your containers at scale.\nFast, secure and simple, Ubuntu powers millions of PCs worldwide.\n"
LABEL "org.opencontainers.image.title"="ubuntu"
LABEL "org.opencontainers.image.version"="26.04"
ENV PATH="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
CMD ["/bin/bash"]
